test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: The guards stood in **pike **formation outside the hall.

options.text: The fisherman caught a long pike near the riverbank.
The soldier was punished by being fastened to a pike.
The warrior thrust his pike into the shield wall.
The pike glittered in the museum display.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pike"** in the given sentence refers to a "long spear used historically by soldiers". (भाला / लंबा भाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The guards held their pikes upright as the king passed by.
 
 
 
• In the correct option, the word **"pike"** is used as a "type of fish", which is a homonym of the original meaning. (मछली की एक जाति)
 
 
• **Example:** The chef prepared a delicious dish using freshly caught pike.
 
 
 
• Thus, Option 1 contains the correct homonym of the highlighted word.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Option 2:** The soldier was punished by being fastened to a pike. (यहाँ "pike" का अर्थ—सज़ा देने हेतु खूँटे/दंड स्तंभ) (खूँटा)

 
 
• **Example:** Criminals in old times were tied to a pike as punishment.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The warrior thrust his pike into the shield wall. (यहाँ "pike" का अर्थ—लंबा भाला) (भाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The warrior’s pike pierced through the enemy defense.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The pike glittered in the museum display. (यहाँ भी "pike" का अर्थ—ऐतिहासिक हथियार) (भाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient pike was preserved in excellent condition.
 
 

3f:Tcba,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
